title: Print in PETG
summary: PETG, the material R4 names: it holds the pump without creeping, and it prints on the person's own 220 mm printer

rejected.why: creeps under sustained load at room temperature — a PLA bracket that passes every evaluator here still sags over months, and no static analysis sees it

returns_if.text: when the load is no longer sustained: a bracket that holds the pump only while it is serviced

rejected.why: the model holds no ABS properties (MATERIALS has petg, pla and alu6061), so no evaluator here could check it

returns_if.text: when ABS is added to MATERIALS with conservative FDM values and its claims are checked

rejected.why: Robin prints their own parts, in PETG (R4); a machined part is bought, and at triple the mass
